version_boundary_check: PASS: energy metadata remain constant after the explicit P1-P5 correction; no checked channel shows a boundary jump larger than its local p99 one-step variability.
direction_policy: East and West are reconstructed and propagated separately before any central estimator is formed.
quality_policy: L2 fill/nonfinite values and unresolved yaw are hard-invalid. Valid L2 averages are not time-interpolated or smoothed. Instrument-quality flagged spikes are not removed as outliers.

calibration.note: The controlled L2 files retain legacy P1-P5 bounds; the adapter applies the published GOES-19 correction only under that signature.

known_product_limitations: GOES-19 provisional documentation warns that P1-P9 background outside SEP intervals can exceed the actual GCR proton background.
P8C on-orbit cross-calibration may be high; this is retained as a calibration limitation rather than silently corrected beyond the controlled P1-P5 update.
disposition: PASS for audited five-minute environmental input with explicit version, quality, direction, calibration, and provenance metadata; absolute downstream rate remains PARTIAL for independent sigma/extrapolation reasons documented in validation_report.json.
